name: alia-plugin-sql
description: SQLTools-style Postgres panel for VesnALIA: all-databases tree, schema completion with table aliases, query session persistence, duplicate connections, controlled write/DDL. Agents: sql_query + sql_list_connections.

alia.name: SQL
alia.description: Postgres in VesnALIA: browse all databases, schema-aware completion, controlled write/DDL (Agent write / Allow DDL on by default for new connections).

scripts.test:completion: rm -rf /tmp/alia-sql-completion-test && mkdir -p /tmp/alia-sql-completion-test && tsc --strict --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --outDir /tmp/alia-sql-completion-test --rootDir . lib/sql-completion/complete.ts lib/sql-completion/context.ts lib/sql-completion/rank.ts lib/sql-completion/keywords.ts lib/sql-completion/types.ts lib/sql-completion/table-alias.ts lib/sql-completion/index.ts lib/sql-completion/complete.test.ts lib/sql-statements.ts && node --test /tmp/alia-sql-completion-test/lib/sql-completion/complete.test.js
